arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ يَا مَنْ لا يَصِفُهُ نَعْتُ الْوَاصِفِينَ ،
transliteration: allāhumma yā man lā yaṣifu-hu naʿtu al-wāṣifīn
english_text: O God, O He whom the depiction of the describers fails to describe!

arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ يُجَاوِزُهُ رَجَاءُ الرَّاجِينَ ،
transliteration: wa yā man lā yujāwizu-hu rajāʾu al-rājīn
english_text: O He beyond whom passes not the hope of the hopers!

arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ يَضِيعُ لَدَيْهِ أَجْرُ الْمُحْسِنِينَ،
transliteration: wayā man lā yaḍīʿu ladayhi ajru almuḥsinīn
english_text: O He with whom is not lost the wage of the good-doers!

arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ هُوَ مُنْتَهَى خَوْفِ الْعَابِدِيْنَ،
transliteration: wayā man huwa muntahā khawfi al-ʿābidīn
english_text: O He who is the ultimate object of the fear of the worshipers!

arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ هُوَ غَايَةُ خَشْيَةِ الْمُتَّقِينَ.
transliteration: wa yā man huwa ghāyat khawfi al-muttaqīn
english_text: O He who is the utmost limit of the dread of the godfearing!

arabic_text: هَذا مَقَامُ مَنْ تَدَاوَلَتْهُ أَيْدِي الذُّنُوبِ ،
transliteration: hādhā maqāmu man tadāwaltahu aydī al-dhunūb
english_text: This is the station of him whom sins have passed from hand to hand.

arabic_text: وَقَادَتْهُ أَزِمَّةُ الْخَطَايَا ، وَاسْتَحْوَذَ عَلَيْهِ الشَّيْطَانُ،
transliteration: waqādathu ʾazimmatu al-khaṭāyā wa astaḥwaḏa ʿalayhi al-shayṭān
english_text: Offenses' reins have led him on, and Satan has gained mastery over him.

arabic_text: فَقَصَّرَ عَمَّا أَمَرْتَ بِهِ تَفْرِيطَاً، وَتَعَاطى مَا نَهَيْتَ عَنْهُ تَغْرِيراً، كَالْجاهِلِ بِقُدْرَتِكَ عَلَيْهِ، أَوْ كَالْمُنْكِرِ فَضْلَ إحْسَانِكَ إلَيْهِ،
transliteration: faqassara ʿammā amarta bihī tafriṭan wa taʿāṭṭā mā nahayta ʿanhū taġrīran ka-l-jāhili bi-qudratika ʿalayhi aw ka'l-munkiri fadla iḥsānika ilayhi
english_text: He fell short of what Thou hast commanded through neglect and he pursued what Thou hast prohibited in delusion, like one ignorant of Thy power over him or one who denies the bounty of Thy beneficence toward him,

arabic_text: حَتَّى إذَا انْفَتَحَ لَهُ بَصَرُ الْهُدَى، وَتَقَشَّعَتْ عَنْهُ سَحَائِبُ الْعَمَى أَحْصَى مَا ظَلَمَ بِهِ نَفْسَهُ، وَفَكَّرَ فِيمَا خَالَفَ بِهِ رَبَّهُ،
transliteration: ḥattā ʾiḏā ʾinfataḥa lahū baṣaru l-hudā wa taqashaʿat ʿanhu sahāʾibu al-ʿamā aḥṣā mā ẓalama bihi nafsahu wafakkara feemaa khaalafa bihi rabbaahu
english_text: until, when the eye of guidance was opened for him and the clouds of blindness were dispelled, he reckoned that through which he had wronged himself and reflected upon that in which he had opposed his Lord.

arabic_text: فَرَأى كَبِيْرَ عِصْيَانِهِ كَبِيْراً، وَجَلِيل مُخالفَتِهِ جَلِيْلاً،
transliteration: fa ra'a kabiran ʿisyanihil kabiran, wa jalil mukhalifatihil jalilan
english_text: He saw his vast disobedience as vast and his great opposition as great.

arabic_text: فَأَقْبَلَ نَحْوَكَ مُؤَمِّلاً لَكَ، مُسْتَحْيِيَاً مِنْكَ، وَوَجَّهَ رَغْبَتَهُ إلَيْكَ ثِقَةً بِكَ،
transliteration: fa'aqbal naḥwaka mu'ammilan laka mustaḥyian minka wa wajjah raghbatahu ilayka thiqatan bika
english_text: So turned to Thee, hoping in Thee and ashamed before Thee, and he directed his beseeching toward Thee, having trust in Thee.

arabic_text: فَأَمَّكَ بِطَمَعِهِ يَقِيناً، وَقَصَدَكَ بِخَوْفِهِ إخْلاَصَاً،
transliteration: fa'ammaka bi-tamaʿihi yaqīnan, wa-qasada-ka bi-khawfihi ikhlāṣan
english_text: He repaired to Thee in his longing with certitude and he went straight to Thee in fear with sincerity.

arabic_text: قَدْ خَلاَ طَمَعُهُ مِنْ كُلِّ مَطْمُوع فِيهِ غَيْرِكَ، وَأَفْرَخَ رَوْعُهُ مِنْ كُلِّ مَحْذُور مِنْهُ سِوَاكَ،
transliteration: qad khalā ṭamahu min kulli maṭmūʿ fīhi ghayrika waʾfraqa raʾʿuhu min kulli mahdhūr minhu siwāka
english_text: His longing was devoid of every object of longing but Thee, and his fright departed from every object of fear but Thee.

arabic_text: فَمَثَّلَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْـكَ مُتَضَرِّعـاً، وَغَمَّضَ بَصَرَهُ إلَى الأرْضِ مُتَخَشِّعَاً، وَطَأطَأَ رَأسَهُ لِعِزَّتِكَ مُتَذَلِّلاً،
transliteration: famaththala bayna yadayka mutadarrīʿan wa ghammaða baṣarahu ilā al-arḍi mutakhshiʿan waṭaʾaṭaʾa raʾsahu liʿizzatika mutadhallilan
english_text: So he stood before Thee pleading, his eyes turned toward the ground in humbleness, his head bowed before Thy might in lowliness;

arabic_text: وَأَبَثَّكَ مِنْ سِرِّهِ مَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنْهُ خَضُوعاً،
transliteration: wa 'abaththaka min sirrihi mā 'anta 'a'lamu bihi minhu khadhū'an
english_text: he revealed to Thee in meekness those secrets of his which Thou knowest better than he;

arabic_text: وَعَدَّدَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِهِ مَا أَنْتَ أَحْصَى لَهَا خُشُوعاً
transliteration: waʿaddada min dhunubihi mā anta aḥṣā lahā khushūʿan
english_text: he numbered for Thee in humility those sins of his which Thou countest better than he;

arabic_text: وَاسْتَغَاثَ بِكَ مِنْ عَظِيمِ مَاوَقَعَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِكَ وَقَبِيحِ مَا فَضَحَهُ فِي حُكْمِكَ مِنْ ذُنُوب أدْبَرَتْ لَذَّاتُهَا فَذَهَبَتْ، وَأَقَامَتْ تَبِعَاتُهَا فَلَزِمَتْ،
transliteration: wa-istaghatha bika min ʿadheem ma waqaʿa bihi fi ʿilmika wa qabihi ma fadahahu fi hukmika min dhunūb adbarat ladhātuhā faḏahabat wa-aqāmat tabiʿātuha falaẓimat
english_text: he sought help from Thee before the dreadful into which he has fallen in Thy knowledge and the ugly which has disgraced him in Thy judgement: the sins whose pleasures have turned their backs and gone and whose evil consequences have stayed and stuck fast.

arabic_text: لا يُنْكِرُ يَا إلهِي عَدْلَكَ إنْ عَاقَبْتَهُ، وَلا يَسْتَعْظِمُ عَفْوَكَ إنْ عَفَوْتَ عَنْهُ وَرَحِمْتَهُ; لأِنَّكَ الرَّبُّ الْكَرِيمُ الَّذِي لا يَتَعَاظَمُهُ غُفْرَانُ الذَّنْبِ الْعَظِيم.
transliteration: lā yunkiru yā ilāhī ʿadlaka in ʿāqabtahu walā yastaʿẓimu ʿafwaka in ʿafawta ʿanhu wa raḥimtahu li-annaka al-rabbu al-karīmu alladhī lā yataʿāẓamuhu ghufraanu al-đẹnbi al-ʿażīm
english_text: He will not deny Thy justice, my God, if Thou punishest him, nor will he consider Thy pardon great if Thou pardonest him and hast mercy upon him, for Thou art the Generous Lord for whom the forgiveness of great sins is nothing great!

arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ فَهَا أَنَا ذَا قَدْ جئْتُكَ مُطِيعاً لاِمْرِكَ فِيمَا أَمَرْتَ بِهِ مِنَ الدُّعَاءِ، مَتَنَجِّزاً وَعْدَكَ فِيمَا وَعَدْتَ بِهِ مِنَ الإجَابَةِ إذْ تَقُولُ (اُدْعُونِي أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ).
transliteration: allāhumma fahā annā dhā qad ji'tuka muṭīʿan la-ʾimrik fīmā ʾamart bihi mina al-duʿāʾi matanajjizan waʿdaka feema waʿadtaha min al-ijabahti idh taqulu (udʿūnī ʾastajib lakum)
english_text: O God, so here I am: I have come to Thee obeying Thy command (for Thou hast commanded supplication) and asking the fulfilment of Thy promise, (for Thou hast promised to respond): Thou hast said, "Supplicate Me and I will respond to you" (40:60).

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَالْقَنِي بِمَغْفِـرَتِكَ كَمَا لَقِيتُكَ بِإقْرَارِي وَارْفَعْنِي عَنْ مَصَارعِ الذُّنُوبِ كَمَا وَضَعْتُ لَكَ نَفْسِي وَاسْتُرْنِي بِسِتْرِكَ كَمَا تَأَنَّيْتَنِي عَنِ الانْتِقَامِ مِنِّي.
transliteration: allāhumma faṣalli ʿalā muḥammadin wa ālih wa al-qani bi-maghfiratika kama laqituka bi-iqrari wa arfaʿnī ʿan maṣāriʿi al-ḏunūb kamā waḍaʿtuka nafsī wa-isturni bi-sitrika kama ta'anaytani 'anil intiqami minni
english_text: O God, so bless Muhammad and his Household, meet me with Thy forgiveness just as I have met Thee with my confession, lift me up from the fatal infirmities of sins just as I have let myself down before Thee, and cover me with Thy covering just as Thou hast shown no haste to take vengeance on me!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَثَبِّتْ فِي طَاعَتِكَ نِيَّتِيْ، وَأَحْكِمْ فِي عِبَادَتِكَ بَصِيـرَتِي، وَوَفِّقْنِي مِنَ الأَعْمَالِ لِمَا تَغْسِلُ بِهِ دَنَسَ الخَطَايَا عَنِّي،
transliteration: allāhumma wathabbit fī ṭāʿatika niyyatī wa aḥkim fī ʿibādatika baṣīratī wa waffiqnī min al-aʿmālِ lima taghsilu bihi danasa al-khataaya anni
english_text: O God, make firm my intention to obey Thee, strengthen my insight in worshipping Thee, give me the success of works which will wash away the defilement of offenses,

arabic_text: وَتَوَفَّنِي عَلَى مِلَّتِكَ وَمِلَّةِ نَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّد عَلَيْهِ السَّـلامُ إذَا تَوَفَّيْتَنِي.
transliteration: wa tawaffanī ʿalā millatika wa millati nabiyyika muḥammad ʿalayhi as-salāmu ʾidhā tawaffaytanī
english_text: and take me when Thou takest me in the creed of Thy prophet Muhammad (upon him be peace).

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أَتُوبُ إلَيْـكَ فِي مَقَامِي هَذَا مِنْ كَبَائِرِ ذُنُوبِي وَصَغَائِرِهَا وَبَوَاطِنِ سَيِّئآتِي وَظَوَاهِرِهَا، وَسَوالِفِ زَلاَّتِي وَحَوَادِثِهَا،
transliteration: allāhumma innī atūbu ilayka fī maqāmī hādhā min kabā'iri dhunūbī wa ṣaghā'irihā wa bawāṭinī sayyiāti wa ẓawāhirihā wasawālifi zalātī waḥawādithihā
english_text: O God, I repent to Thee in this my station from my sins, great and small, my evil deeds, inward and outward, my lapses, past and recent,

arabic_text: تَوْبَةَ مَنْ لا يُحَدِّثُ نَفْسَهُ بِمَعْصِيَةٍ وَلاَ يُضْمِرُ أَنْ يَعُودَ فِي خَطِيئَةٍ،
transliteration: tawbatu man la yuḥaddithu nafsahu bimaʿsiyah wala yudmiru an ya'uda fi khatiyatin
english_text: with the repentance of one who does not tell himself that he might disobey or secretly think that he might return to an offense.

arabic_text: وَقَدْ قُلْتَ يَا إلهِي فِي مُحْكَمِ كِتابِكَ إنَّكَ تَقْبَلُ التَّوْبَةَ عَنْ عِبَادِكَ، وَتَعْفُو عَنِ السَّيِّئاتِ، وَتُحِبُّ التَّوَّابِينَ، فَاقْبَلْ تَوْبَتِي كَمَا وَعَدْتَ وَأعْفُ عَنْ سَيِّئاتِي كَمَا ضَمِنْتَ،
transliteration: waqad qultaya ʾilahiyafī muḥkami kitābik 'innaka taqbalu at-tawbata 'an 'ibadika wa taʿfu ʿani al-sayyi’at wa tuḥibbu al-tawwabīn faqbal tawbati kama waʿadtawaʾfu ʿan sayyiati kama ḍamint
english_text: Thou hast said, my God, in the firm text of Thy Book, that Thou 'acceptest repentance from Thy servants, pardonest evil deeds' (ref.42:25), and lovest the repenters (ref.2:222), so accept my repentance as Thou hast promised, pardon my evil deeds as thou hast guaranteed,

arabic_text: وَأَوْجِبْ لِي مَحَبَّتَكَ كَمَا شَـرَطْتَ،
transliteration: waʾawjib li mahabbataka kama sharatt
english_text: and make obligatory toward me Thy love as Thou hast stipulated!

arabic_text: وَلَـكَ يَـا رَبِّ شَـرْطِي أَلاّ أَعُودَ فِي مَكْرُوهِكَ، وَضَمَانِي أَلاّ أَرْجِعَ فِي مَذْمُومِكَ، وَعَهْدِي أَنْ أَهْجُرَ جَمِيعَ مَعَاصِيكَ.
transliteration: wa laka yā rabbī sharṭī alā aʿūda fī makrūhik waḍamānī allā ʾarjiʿa fī maḏmūmika waʿahdi an ahjura jamiʿa maʿasiyika
english_text: To Thee, my Lord, belongs my stipulation that I will not return to what is disliked by Thee, my guarantee that I will not go back to what Thou blamest, and my covenant that I will stay away from acts of disobedience to Thee.

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا عَمِلْتُ فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا عَلِمْتَ، وَاصْرِفْنِي بِقُدْرَتِكَ إلَى مَا أَحْبَبْتَ.
transliteration: allāhumma innaka aʿlamu bimā ʿamiltu faghfir lī mā ʿalimta waṣrifnī biqudratika ilā mā aḥbabta
english_text: O God, Thou knowest better what I have done, so forgive me what Thou knowest and turn me through Thy power to what Thou lovest!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَعَلَيَّ تَبِعَاتٌ قَدْ حَفِظْتُهُنَّ، وَتَبِعَاتٌ قَدْ نَسيتُهُنَّ، وَكُلُّهُنَّ بِعَيْنِكَ الَّتِي لاَ تَنَـامُ، وَعِلْمِكَ الَّذِي لا يَنْسَى
transliteration: allāhumma wa ʿalayya tabiʿātun qad ḥafiztu hunna wa tabiʿātun qad nasytuhunna wa kulluhun bi'aynik allati la tanam wa ʿilmika alladhī lā yansā
english_text: O God, counted against me are claims that stay in my memory and claims that I have forgotten, while all of them remain in Thy eye that does not sleep and Thy knowledge that does not forget!

arabic_text: فَعَوِّضْ مِنْهَا أَهْلَهَا وَاحْطُطْ عَنّي وِزْرَهَا، وَخَفِّفْ عَنِّي ثِقْلَهَا، وَاعْصِمْنِي مِنْ أَنْ اُقَارِفَ مِثْلَهَا.
transliteration: faʿawwidh minhā ahlahā wa-aḥtuṭ ḥannī wizrahā wa khaffif ʿanni thiqlahā, waʾaṣimnī min an uqārifamithlahā
english_text: So compensate their owners, lighten their load upon me, lift up their weight from me, and preserve me from approaching their like!
